text: The property lost 25.5 ha of tree cover in 2015 due to a significant tree-cover loss event. This event is supported by evidence from the Hansen Global Forest Change dataset (GFC-2025-v1.13), which tracks stand-replacing tree-cover loss at a 30 m resolution annually. The loss in 2015 is one of several historical events outside the claim interval (2021-2025) but is clearly documented in the data. The change is not attributed to regulatory or compliance issues, nor is it related to any specific observable pattern or trend within the claim period. The data indicates that this was a distinct event, separate from other loss events in 2008, 2017, and 2020.
